jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Software Development Engineer, SA
Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a motivated Full Stack Software Engineer to join the IS Tech APAC team.
The role provides opportunities to develop and support enterprise applications. We are looking for recent graduates with a solid software engineering foundation, strong interest in full-stack development, and enthusiasm for applying Cloud, AI, and modern engineering technologies to real-world solutions.
What You Will Do
Develop and enhance enterprise applications using Java, Spring / Spring Boot, Oracle, SQL, and REST APIs.
Develop backend services and business logic for transaction processing, data validation, reconciliation, and workflow automation.
Develop and maintain web applications using modern frontend technologies such as React and JavaScript / TypeScript.
Build and support applications running on public cloud platforms such as AWS.
Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Apply engineering practices including unit testing, TDD, Git, CI/CD, and code reviews.
Explore and apply Generative AI and AI-assisted development to improve engineering productivity and application capabilities.
Collaborate with business analysts, product owners, and engineering teams to deliver reliable and scalable solutions.
What We Value
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Solid programming fundamentals with attention to code quality.
A proactive learner with good communication and collaboration skills.
Interest in Cloud, AI, and modern software engineering.
Curiosity and willingness to learn and adopt emerging technologies.
Basic Qualifications
Education & Qualifications / Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
Good knowledge of Java, object-oriented programming, and Spring / Spring Boot.
Good understanding of Oracle, SQL, and relational databases.
Understanding of REST APIs and web application architecture.
Basic knowledge of React and JavaScript / TypeScript.
Basic understanding of AWS or other public cloud platforms, including common cloud concepts and services.
Familiarity with Git, unit testing, CI/CD, and Agile development.
Basic understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, and AI-assisted software development.
Good written and spoken English.
Preferred Qualifications
Hands-on experience with AWS, cloud-native development, or application deployment on public cloud.
Exposure to MQ / Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, or microservices.
Experience Using GitHub Copilot Or Other AI-assisted Development Tools.
Understanding or hands-on experience with AI Agents, AI Skills, MCP (Model Context Protocol), prompt engineering, or LLM integration.
Relevant personal projects, hackathons, internships, or academic projects involving Full Stack, Cloud, or AI development.

Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a motivated Software Engineer – Backend to join the Cash Services engineering team.
The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of backend services supporting our Cash platform. The role provides an opportunity to work on enterprise-scale financial applications, cloud-native technologies, microservices, messaging systems, and high-volume transaction processing.
You will work closely with experienced engineers, architects, product managers, business analysts, and QA engineers to build reliable and scalable software solutions while developing your technical and financial domain knowledge.
What You Will Be Responsible For
Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and APIs for the Cash platform.
Develop high-quality software primarily using Java and related backend technologies.
Contribute to the development of microservices and cloud-native applications.
Work with REST APIs, SQL databases, Kafka, and message-based systems.
Participate in the development of applications deployed in Azure and Kubernetes/containerized environments.
Analyze business and technical requirements and implement simple, reliable, and maintainable solutions.
Write unit tests and automated tests to ensure software quality.
Participate in code reviews and continuously improve coding and engineering practices.
Troubleshoot application issues with support and guidance from experienced engineers.
Contributes to application performance, reliability, security, and observability improvements.
Participate in Agile development activities including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
Collaborate with global engineering teams and business partners.
Learn and apply emerging technologies and modern software engineering practices, including AI-assisted development tools.

We are seeking a motivated Junior Software Developer to join our engineering team on a full-time basis. You will be involved in the development and support of enterprise Java-based applications, working across both front-end and back-end layers.

Proficiency in Java and Spring / Spring Boot.

Good command of English, written and spoken.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

jobs.title: Business System Analyst, AVP
jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
We are seeking a client- and user-facing Business Systems Analyst who thrives in a collaborative environment and enjoys solving complex business challenges through technology.
The ideal candidate will partner with business stakeholders and development teams to analyze requirements, shape solutions, and support delivery across the full software development lifecycle. Success in this role requires strong financial services knowledge, analytical thinking, communication skills, stakeholder management, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a global environment.
Based in Hangzhou, China, this role provides the opportunity to work with global clients and stakeholders across a wide range of business and technology initiatives.
Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining is a Business Analysis group within State Street Global Technology Services (GTS). GTS is a key enabler of State Street’s business strategy, delivering technology solutions and insights that support our business lines and clients globally.
Working across business, operations, and technology teams, the group drives strategic initiatives, platform enhancements, process optimization, and technology transformation.
As a Business Systems Analyst, you will serve as a key link between business stakeholders and technology teams, translating business needs into scalable solutions and ensuring successful delivery throughout the project lifecycle. This role offers broad exposure to financial services, business operations, and enterprise technology, while providing opportunities to make a meaningful impact across global initiatives.
Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are ready to take on.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As a Business Systems Analyst, Assistant Vice President, you will:
Partner with external clients and internal business users to understand business objectives, challenges, and user needs.
Lead the analysis of complex business workflows, data flows, operating models, system interactions, and end-to-end business scenarios.
Evaluate existing processes and systems, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, and help define practical and scalable future-state solutions.
Translate business needs into clear, complete, and actionable requirements for technology teams.
Produce and maintain high-quality business analysis artifacts, including business and functional requirements, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, wireframes, data mappings, traceability documentation, and user guides.
Facilitate requirement-gathering workshops, solution discussions, walkthroughs, and stakeholder review sessions.
Work closely with development, architecture, testing, operations, and production support teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Participate in Agile delivery teams as a Business Analyst or Product Owner, depending on project needs.
Support solution validation, testing, implementation, user readiness, and post-production activities to ensure delivered solutions meet agreed business requirements.
Identify, assess, resolve, or escalate risks, issues, dependencies, and requirement gaps throughout the delivery lifecycle.
Communicate project status, decisions, risks, and required actions clearly to business and technology stakeholders.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with global business and technology partners by communicating effectively in both business and technical language.
Manage multiple priorities and provide business analysis leadership across concurrent initiatives.
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of business analysis standards, practices, templates, and governance.
Coach and mentor junior Business Analysts, provide guidance and quality reviews, and act as a role model for the wider team.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Strong ownership and the ability to drive work forward with minimal supervision.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with strong interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities.
Solid understanding of how technology, data, and operational processes work together to support business and client outcomes.
Ability to understand complex business problems and translate them into clear requirements and practical solution options.
Good understanding of financial products, financial services operations, or related business processes.
Strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams.
Ability to lead discussions, facilitate workshops, influence decisions, and build alignment across business and technology teams.
Detail-oriented, quality-focused, and committed to producing accurate and consistent deliverables.
Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery environments.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or above in Finance, Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline.
6+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, Product Owner, or in a similar role within financial services, software development, data, or technology delivery.
Demonstrated experience leading business analysis activities for complex, cross-functional, or global initiatives.
Experience working directly with business users, clients, technology teams, and senior stakeholders.
Experience producing functional requirements, process models, user stories, acceptance criteria, data mappings, and other business analysis deliverables.
Experience in any of the following areas is highly desirable:
Financial products, investment servicing, asset management, banking, or capital markets.
Agile delivery tools and practices, such as Jira, backlog management, sprint planning, and story refinement.
CFA qualification or successful completion of the CFA Level I examination.
Additional Requirements
N.A
About State Street
What we do.
State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
Work, Live and Grow.
We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.
Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.
We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. Who We Are Looking For

We are seeking a client- and user-facing Business Systems Analyst who thrives in a collaborative environment and enjoys solving complex business challenges through technology.

The ideal candidate will partner with business stakeholders and development teams to analyze requirements, shape solutions, and support delivery across the full software development lifecycle. Success in this role requires strong financial services knowledge, analytical thinking, communication skills, stakeholder management, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a global environment.

Based in Hangzhou, China, this role provides the opportunity to work with global clients and stakeholders across a wide range of business and technology initiatives.

Why this role is important to us

The team you will be joining is a Business Analysis group within State Street Global Technology Services (GTS). GTS is a key enabler of State Street’s business strategy, delivering technology solutions and insights that support our business lines and clients globally.

Working across business, operations, and technology teams, the group drives strategic initiatives, platform enhancements, process optimization, and technology transformation.

As a Business Systems Analyst, you will serve as a key link between business stakeholders and technology teams, translating business needs into scalable solutions and ensuring successful delivery throughout the project lifecycle. This role offers broad exposure to financial services, business operations, and enterprise technology, while providing opportunities to make a meaningful impact across global initiatives.

Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are ready to take on.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As a Business Systems Analyst, Assistant Vice President, you will:

  • Partner with external clients and internal business users to understand business objectives, challenges, and user needs.

Ensure application designs meet security, audit, resilience, and performance requirements.

Develop and deploy applications on AWS and Azure platforms.
Drive modernization of legacy systems into cloud-native architectures.
Implement observability, monitoring, and performance optimization solutions.

Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Business SMEs, Operations teams, and executive stakeholders.

5+ years of enterprise software development experience.
Strong Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST API development.

Strong system integration and distributed systems knowledge.
Experience building scalable enterprise applications.

Experience using Generative AI tools in software development.

Experience with Github Copilot, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies.
Ability to identify and deliver AI use cases that improve engineering productivity and operational efficiency.

Experience leading development teams and mentoring engineers.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work with global teams across APAC, EMEA, and North America.

Shareholder Services, Investment Management, Transfer Agency, or Financial Services experience.
Experience with workflow platforms, transaction processing systems, or investment operations.

jobs.descriptionText:
Role purpose
You'll build and run the CI/CD pipelines which build state of the art application platforms and deploy AWS infrastructure for a multi-year programme moving a large portfolio of middle-office applications to AWS. This is a
hands-on engineering role
: most of your day is spent writing pipeline code, Terraform and scripts, and fixing builds and deployments. You'll work closely with full-stack application teams (ReactJS and Java), database engineers and SRE.
Key responsibilities
Build tooling
Set up and maintain front-end builds with npm and pnpm, vite, babel etc including workspaces/monorepos, dependency caching, lockfile management and private registries.
Set up and maintain Java builds with Maven and Gradle, including multi-module projects, dependency management and build performance.
Publish and version artifacts through Artifactory (or similar), and keep builds reproducible.
CI/CD pipelines
Design and build pipelines in Harness and GitHub Actions for build, test, security scanning and deployment across all environments.
Create reusable pipeline templates so application teams can onboard quickly and consistently.
Add quality and security gates: unit tests, code coverage, SAST/SCA scanning, container image scanning and approval steps.
Support blue/green and canary deployments, automated rollback and release tracking that meets State Street change management requirements.
Infrastructure as code and AWS
Write and maintain Terraform modules for AWS: VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS/EKS, ALB, S3, RDS and related services.
Manage Terraform state, module versioning and policy checks; detect and fix configuration drift.
Build and run container platforms (Docker, ECS/EKS) for application workloads.
Integrate secrets management (HashiCorp Vault/CyberArk) into pipelines and runtime environments.
Linux
Build, harden and automate Linux servers and container images for applications moving off Solaris and Windows.
Write Shell and Python scripts for automation, troubleshooting and operational tasks.
Support migration of batch jobs and file transfers to the target platform (e.g. AutoSys, MFX/SFTP).
Reliability and collaboration
Work with SRE to add logging, metrics and alerting (e.g. Dynatrace, Splunk) to pipelines and environments.
Troubleshoot build, deployment and environment issues for application teams.
Document runbooks and standards, and use AI assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot) to speed up pipeline, Terraform and script development, with review.
Required Experience And Skills
5+ years in DevOps, build or platform engineering roles.
Front-end builds: practical experience with npm and pnpm for React/TypeScript projects.
Java builds: strong experience with Maven and Gradle.
Terraform: writing production modules and managing state for AWS.
AWS: hands-on experience with core compute, networking, IAM, containers and managed services.
CI/CD: building pipelines in Harness and/or GitHub Actions; Jenkins experience is a plus.
Linux: strong administration, hardening and scripting (Bash, Python).
Docker and Kubernetes/ECS/EKS.
Git, branching strategies and pull-request workflows.
Preferred
Experience in a regulated financial services environment.
Experience with secrets management (Vault, CyberArk) and security scanning tools (e.g. SonarQube, Black Duck, Checkmarx).
Experience with database change pipelines (Liquibase/Flyway).
AWS certification (DevOps Engineer or SysOps Administrator) and/or HashiCorp Terraform certification.
Success measures (first 12 months)
Reusable pipeline templates adopted by all modernization and migration teams.
All target environments provisioned through Terraform, with no manual infrastructure changes.
Faster, more reliable builds and deployments, measured against a baseline.
No audit findings related to pipeline controls or secrets handling.

  • Set up and maintain front-end builds with npm and pnpm, vite, babel etc including workspaces/monorepos, dependency caching, lockfile management and private registries.
  • Set up and maintain Java builds with Maven and Gradle, including multi-module projects, dependency management and build performance.
  • Publish and version artifacts through Artifactory (or similar), and keep builds reproducible.


CI/CD pipelines

  • Design and build pipelines in Harness and GitHub Actions for build, test, security scanning and deployment across all environments.
  • Create reusable pipeline templates so application teams can onboard quickly and consistently.
  • Add quality and security gates: unit tests, code coverage, SAST/SCA scanning, container image scanning and approval steps.
  • Support blue/green and canary deployments, automated rollback and release tracking that meets State Street change management requirements.


Infrastructure as code and AWS

  • Write and maintain Terraform modules for AWS: VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS/EKS, ALB, S3, RDS and related services.
  • Manage Terraform state, module versioning and policy checks; detect and fix configuration drift.
  • Build and run container platforms (Docker, ECS/EKS) for application workloads.
  • Integrate secrets management (HashiCorp Vault/CyberArk) into pipelines and runtime environments.


Linux

  • Build, harden and automate Linux servers and container images for applications moving off Solaris and Windows.
  • Write Shell and Python scripts for automation, troubleshooting and operational tasks.
  • Support migration of batch jobs and file transfers to the target platform (e.g. AutoSys, MFX/SFTP).


Reliability and collaboration

  • Work with SRE to add logging, metrics and alerting (e.g. Dynatrace, Splunk) to pipelines and environments.
  • Troubleshoot build, deployment and environment issues for application teams.
  • Document runbooks and standards, and use AI assistants (e.g. GitHub Copilot) to speed up pipeline, Terraform and script development, with review.


Required Experience And Skills

  • 5+ years in DevOps, build or platform engineering roles.
  • Front-end builds: practical experience with npm and pnpm for React/TypeScript projects.
  • Java builds: strong experience with Maven and Gradle.
  • Terraform: writing production modules and managing state for AWS.
  • AWS: hands-on experience with core compute, networking, IAM, containers and managed services.
  • CI/CD: building pipelines in Harness and/or GitHub Actions; Jenkins experience is a plus.
  • Linux: strong administration, hardening and scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Docker and Kubernetes/ECS/EKS.
  • Git, branching strategies and pull-request workflows.


Preferred

  • Experience in a regulated financial services environment.
  • Experience with secrets management (Vault, CyberArk) and security scanning tools (e.g. SonarQube, Black Duck, Checkmarx).
  • Experience with database change pipelines (Liquibase/Flyway).
  • AWS certification (DevOps Engineer or SysOps Administrator) and/or HashiCorp Terraform certification.


Success measures (first 12 months)

  • Reusable pipeline templates adopted by all modernization and migration teams.
  • All target environments provisioned through Terraform, with no manual infrastructure changes.
  • Faster, more reliable builds and deployments, measured against a baseline.
  • No audit findings related to pipeline controls or secrets handling.

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
We are seeking an experienced Vice President to lead our Private Markets Operations team. The team delivers high-quality, scalable administration, valuation, accounting and performance services to AO and AM clients across global markets.
The successful candidate will bring strong people leadership, operational and risk judgment, client management and transformation capabilities. You will lead a large, multi-layer operations organization. You will also partner closely with global Product, Client Service, Technology and Operations teams to strengthen service delivery, drive transformation and build a sustainable future operating model.
Why This Role Is Important to Us
Our institutional clients depend on us for accurate, timely and transparent data across their private equity, private credit, real estate and infrastructure portfolios. This data feeds accounting, custody, performance, risk and client reporting, so its accuracy directly affects client decisions and trust. In this role, you will balance operational excellence day to day with long-term transformation.
Key Responsabilities
Operations & Client Leadership
Provide overall leadership and governance for private markets service delivery across multiple regions and service models. This includes document management, cash flow processing, valuation, commitment monitoring, look-through and performance reporting.
Ensure consistent delivery against client SLAs, KPIs, risk and quality standards.
Act as a senior escalation point for complex client and operational matters.
Partner with Client Service and global stakeholders to resolve cross-functional issues and set clear accountability.
Risk & Governance
Maintain a strong operational risk and control environment, including procedures, reconciliations, exception management and root-cause remediation.
Oversee service issues, incidents, controls, operational resilience, audit and compliance.
Ensure transformation and operating-model changes keep appropriate controls and clearly defined ownership.
Transformation & Operating Model
Lead strategic transformation initiatives, including process redesign, automation, system migrations and operating-model changes.
Drive standardization, automation and scalable solutions while balancing client needs, operational risk and efficiency.
New Business & Growth
Provide operational leadership for new client onboarding, due diligence, RFPs, client transitions and significant service expansions.
Partner with Product, Client Service, Technology and Transition teams to deliver effective implementation and stabilization after go-live.
Support the development of scalable service models aligned with long-term business growth.
People & Organizational Leadership
Lead and develop a multi-layer management organization, including AVPs and team leads, and build a strong leadership and succession pipeline.
Build capabilities across private markets operations, data, technology, transformation and risk.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement and constructive challenge.
Qualifications & Experience  Required
Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
12+ years of relevant financial services experience, preferably in asset servicing, investment operations or fund administration.
5+ years of senior people-management experience, including leading managers and large operational teams.
Strong understanding of operational risk, controls, governance and service management.
Demonstrated experience in transformation, technology implementation, migration or operating-model redesign.
Proven ability to manage senior clients and global stakeholders across functions and regions.
Excellent communication, influencing, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Fluent in English and Mandarin.
Preferred
Knowledge of private equity, private credit, infrastructure, real assets and other alternative investments.
Experience supporting institutional investors such as pension funds, sovereign wealth funds or other large institutional investors.
Professional qualifications such as CFA, CAIA, CPA or ACCA are preferred but not required.
Leadership Profile
The successful candidate will:
Think enterprise-wide and take ownership beyond organizational boundaries.
Create clarity and accountability in complex or ambiguous situations.
Balance client needs, operational risk, cost and scalability.
Influence Product, Technology and senior stakeholders through strong operational judgment.
Build leaders and sustainable organizational capabilities.
Stay close enough to operations to spot emerging risks, while focusing leadership attention on structural solutions and long-term outcomes.

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
The AVP provides leadership and oversight across multiple fund accounting groups and client relationships. The role is accountable for services quality, control effectiveness, operational resilience, talent development and stakeholder confidence. The AVP needs to translate business priorities into execution plans, anticipates risk, drives scalable improvements, and supports sustainable growth across the AIS operating model.
The AVP requires a broader view when collaborating with various functional teams across the entity. Independent analytics and processing on both existing and new onboard clients/processes. And always open minded for constructive feedbacks and suggestions.
Why This Role Is Important To Us
The team you will be joining is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), a recognized provider of fund accounting and administration services to alternative investment clients. Our team provides end-to-end support for North American clients, with a focus on private equity, Fund of Fund and other complex investment structures. Our team supports key fund operations, including investment activity processing, valuation, NAV package production, and audit-related activities.
Join us if making your mark in the alternative investment industry from day one is a challenge you are up for
What You Will Be Responsible For
As AVP you will:
Business and Client Leadership
Own service delivery across multiple teams and/or complex client relationships, setting clear priorities and ensuring alignment with business and client objectives.
Act as a senior escalation point for operational, accounting and service matters. Communicate options, risks and recommended actions with clarity and judgement.
Represent the team in global meetings and business reviews with senior stakeholders, to lead discussion and ensure commitments are tracked to closure.
Build trusted relationships, to pro-actively identify and ensure understanding of client’s needs and to coordinate internally to support the client’s requirements.
Operational Oversight
Solid accounting knowledge and skills on Private Equity fund end-to-end preparation, including bookkeeping, reconciliation, capital activity, partners’ capital reporting, NAV outcomes, financial statements and client-specific deliverables.
Ensure robust review and control processes are established and effective, maintaining a high standard of accuracy and timeliness across all deliverables.
Coordinate with auditors internal and external to meet deadlines and requirements.
Oversee workload, capacity across the teams, enabling effective prioritization, cross-team training and business continuity.
Support new business, fund growth, migrations and operating model changes through robust planning, readiness assessment and post-implementation oversight.
Risk Control
Promote a strong risk and control culture, ensuring policies, procedures, checklists and control requirements are embedded in daily operations.
Lead audit, compliance, operational risk and incident management activities, ensuring the completeness of evidence and the timely reporting of issues.
Monitor key risk indicators, identify emerging risks and implement remediation plans to address control weaknesses.
Staff Management
Supervise employees on a daily basis, including tasks delegation, employee development, goal setting, performance appraisal, etc.
Regular catch-up and coaching with staff, provide proper solutions and guidance to resolve issues and concerns raised by staff.
Address staff performance or conduct issue in a timely, fair and well-documented manner, partnering with relevant functions as needed.
Manage both the attrition rate and overtime within an acceptable range.
Support succession planning and talent pipeline development to ensure organizational resilience.
Transformation
Drive and work closely with Technology team for process simplification, standardization and automation.
Contribute to budget, headcount and capacity discussions by providing reasoned analysis and practical recommendations.
What We Value
The AVP interacts with all levels of professionals both internally and externally. A strong foundation with communication and interpersonal skills are essential. Candidates must also have the following attributes, skills and experience:
Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, economics or a related discipline.
Professional qualification such as CPA, ACCA, CFA is preferred.
Substantial relevant experience in fund accounting, fund administration or financial services operations. Experience in Private Equity is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated experience leading multiple teams, complex client relationships and staff management.
Deep understanding of Private Markets fund structure, lifecycle, accounting processes, financial reporting and operational control frameworks.
Proactive and multi–task.
Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to present complex matters clearly, influence decisions and negotiate practical outcomes.
8 years+ relevant working experience is required.

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, AVP
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
A highly experienced, hands-on technology leader to serve as Principal Agentic AI Engineer. This role will report to the AI Platform leadership team and will define the target-state Agentic AI platform architecture, establish engineering standards, and guide the delivery and adoption of strategic agentic AI solutions across the organization.
Why this role is important to us
Agentic AI is transforming how organizations automate knowledge-intensive work, accelerate decision-making, and unlock value from enterprise data. Realizing this opportunity at scale requires a secure, governed, and reusable platform that enables engineering and business teams to build production-ready AI solutions. The Principal Agentic AI Engineer will shape this platform, set its technical direction, and ensure that it supports investment performance, investment research, data operations, and related daily operations.
What You Will Be Responsible For
In this role, you will:
Define and own the end-to-end target-state architecture for the Agentic AI platform, including prompt engineering, agent orchestration, memory, tool integration, knowledge management, multi-agent collaboration, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Lead the design and implementation of strategic, production-grade agentic AI solutions for investment performance, investment research, data operations, and related business workflows.
Establish architectural principles, engineering standards, reusable patterns, and guardrails for agentic AI development and adoption.
Define architectural standards for an Iceberg-based Lakehouse, including table design, partitioning, schema evolution, metadata, performance, and lifecycle management.
Design enterprise knowledge capabilities using retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, knowledge graphs, ontologies, metadata, and semantic retrieval.
Review platform, data, and solution designs to ensure alignment with architectural principles, performance expectations, security requirements, and enterprise standards.
Partner with Platform Engineering to align infrastructure, identity and access management, security, observability, CI/CD, AgentOps, and LLMOps capabilities with architectural intent.
Work with Enterprise Architecture, Governance, Risk, and Security teams to meet access-control, Responsible AI, compliance, and audit requirements.
Publish and maintain reference architectures, design guidelines, engineering patterns, and architectural decision records.
Identify architectural risks, technical debt, and improvement opportunities, and guide the evolution of the platform over time.
Mentor senior engineers and influence technical direction across multiple engineering and application teams.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Strong strategic and systems-thinking skills, with sound judgment across innovation, scalability, reliability, cost, security, and governance.
Ability to translate business objectives into practical platform capabilities and executable technical roadmaps.
Ability to influence engineering teams, architects, governance functions, and senior stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority.
Clear and effective communication, including the ability to explain complex AI and data concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
A hands-on, delivery-oriented mindset with strong ownership, curiosity, and commitment to engineering quality.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline.
10+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Proven experience owning or leading enterprise-scale Agentic AI or Generative AI architecture and delivery.
Deep knowledge of agent orchestration, planning, memory, tool calling, evaluation, guardrails, multi-agent systems, and human-in-the-loop design.
Hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, Google ADK, or comparable technologies.
Strong experience with Python, APIs, microservices, distributed systems, event-driven design, and cloud-native engineering.

Job Description

A highly experienced, hands-on technology leader to serve as Principal Agentic AI Engineer. This role will report to the AI Platform leadership team and will define the target-state Agentic AI platform architecture, establish engineering standards, and guide the delivery and adoption of strategic agentic AI solutions across the organization.

Why this role is important to us

Agentic AI is transforming how organizations automate knowledge-intensive work, accelerate decision-making, and unlock value from enterprise data. Realizing this opportunity at scale requires a secure, governed, and reusable platform that enables engineering and business teams to build production-ready AI solutions. The Principal Agentic AI Engineer will shape this platform, set its technical direction, and ensure that it supports investment performance, investment research, data operations, and related daily operations.

What You Will Be Responsible For

In this role, you will:

  • Define and own the end-to-end target-state architecture for the Agentic AI platform, including prompt engineering, agent orchestration, memory, tool integration, knowledge management, multi-agent collaboration, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
  • Lead the design and implementation of strategic, production-grade agentic AI solutions for investment performance, investment research, data operations, and related business workflows.
  • Establish architectural principles, engineering standards, reusable patterns, and guardrails for agentic AI development and adoption.
  • Define architectural standards for an Iceberg-based Lakehouse, including table design, partitioning, schema evolution, metadata, performance, and lifecycle management.
  • Design enterprise knowledge capabilities using retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, knowledge graphs, ontologies, metadata, and semantic retrieval.
  • Review platform, data, and solution designs to ensure alignment with architectural principles, performance expectations, security requirements, and enterprise standards.
  • Partner with Platform Engineering to align infrastructure, identity and access management, security, observability, CI/CD, AgentOps, and LLMOps capabilities with architectural intent.
  • Work with Enterprise Architecture, Governance, Risk, and Security teams to meet access-control, Responsible AI, compliance, and audit requirements.
  • Publish and maintain reference architectures, design guidelines, engineering patterns, and architectural decision records.
  • Identify architectural risks, technical debt, and improvement opportunities, and guide the evolution of the platform over time.
  • Mentor senior engineers and influence technical direction across multiple engineering and application teams.


What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

  • Strong strategic and systems-thinking skills, with sound judgment across innovation, scalability, reliability, cost, security, and governance.
  • Ability to translate business objectives into practical platform capabilities and executable technical roadmaps.

Positive attitude, willingness to learn and openness to feedback.

Role Summary
Design, build, and run core services and reusable components for the open-architecture data platform, enabling scalable ingestion, metadata-driven processing, governance, and reliable multi-engine data consumption. Partner with Platform Engineering and Data Engineering teams to provide secure, observable, production-grade capabilities that support Core Reference, IBOR, and Stamford data initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Design and build backend services and shared libraries that provide platform capabilities, including:
Streaming & batch ingestion frameworks
Metadata-driven pipelines
API and consumption layer integrations
Transformation engine and MDM engine
Engineer reusable platform components aligned with open formats (Iceberg, Parquet), catalog systems (Polaris, Horizon, Unity Catalog), and query engines (Spark, Trino)
Implement platform security controls including role-based access control, authentication, and integration with enterprise entitlements
Build and maintain platform observability (logging, metrics, traces), alerting, and operational dashboards in support of SLAs
Collaborate with architects to define scalable, extensible designs and ensure adherence to open standards
Drive engineering excellence through code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and production readiness practices
Ensure platform services meet enterprise security and compliance requirements (SCC, governance)
Participate in on-call / major incident management and troubleshoot production issues to maintain platform stability
Qualifications
Strong programming skills in Python and Java; knowledge of Rust is a bonus
Strong programming skills in Spark, with hands-on knowledge of optimization and debugging
Hands-on experience with Snowflake and Databricks as data platforms
Strong understanding of SQL optimization, execution, and large-scale analytics
Deep understanding and working knowledge of open table formats such as Apache Iceberg are preferred
Deep understanding of distributed computing and hyperscale
Experience building production-grade services in cloud environments; AWS,GCP and/or Azure is preferred
Familiarity with data catalogs (any of Polaris, Horizon, Unity) and metadata management
Familiarity with streaming pipelines and Kafka is preferred

Experience with CI/CD, containers, and Kubernetes
Financial/data platform background preferred but not required

jobs.title: Alternative Ops Fund Accounting, Associate 2
jobs.descriptionText:
About The Private Markets Fund Of Funds Team
The Private Markets Fund of Funds (FoF) team supports the accounting and administration of investment structures that invest across underlying private market funds and, where applicable, co-investments. The team supports a broad range of private market strategies and structures, delivering accurate accounting records, Net Asset Value (NAV) production, investor reporting, and other client-specific deliverables. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the processing and reporting of capital calls, distributions, cash transactions, management fees, carried interest, expenses, reconciliations, and NAV-related activities. Team members work within established client requirements, operating procedures, and control frameworks to maintain complete and accurate accounting records and support timely reporting.
Who We Are Looking For
The Associate 2, Private Markets Fund of Funds Fund Accountant performs day-to-day accounting and administration activities for private equity FoF and related investment structures. The role processes fund- and investment-level transactions, performs reconciliations, supports NAV production and investor reporting, investigates routine exceptions, and contributes to the initial review of assigned work. The successful candidate will apply established procedures and controls, manage recurring deliverables with increasing independence, and escalate material issues appropriately while maintaining accuracy and quality.
Why This Role Is Important to Us
The team you will join is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), a recognized industry-leading provider of fund accounting, fund administration, and risk services to private equity, private credit, real estate, hedge fund, and other alternative investment clients. Our services are fully integrated to provide comprehensive end-to-end solutions across front-, middle-, and back-office operations.
Join us if you are ready to deepen your knowledge of alternative investments, take greater ownership of recurring fund accounting activities, and contribute to high-quality client service.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As an Associate 2, Private Markets FoF Fund Accountant, you will:
Process day-to-day accounting activities, including capital calls, distributions, management fees, carried interest, income and expenses, cash payments etc. using appropriate supporting documentation, client instructions, and established operating procedures.
Investigate reconciling items, accounting breaks, and exceptions; coordinate timely resolution and escalate material issues or risks to reviewers and managers.
Assist with accurate and timely preparation or initial review of Net Asset Value (NAV) calculations and other client deliverables, including supporting schedules and reasonableness checks.
Maintain complete and accurate accounting records, workpapers, and supporting documentation in accordance with client requirements, internal controls, and operating procedures.
Perform assigned quality checks, identify recurring errors or process gaps, and raise observations to the appropriate reviewer or manager.
Coordinate routine information requests with internal teams and service partners and follow through on outstanding items.
Organize assigned priorities, monitor recurring deadlines, and communicate potential delays or dependencies promptly.
Provide day-to-day guidance to less experienced team members on established procedures, where assigned, while escalating technical or judgmental matters.
Complete required training within deadlines and apply the knowledge gained to assigned responsibilities.
What We Value
Strong attention to detail and a consistent commitment to accuracy and quality.
Analytical thinking and practical problem-solving skills.
Ownership and accountability for assigned responsibilities and deliverables.
Clear written and verbal communication and effective teamwork.
Ability to follow established procedures, apply controls consistently, and recognize when escalation is required.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring deadlines with appropriate supervision.
Willingness to build deeper knowledge of private market, alternative investment products and fund accounting.
Openness to feedback. Commitment to continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, high-quality client service.
Key Skills
Working knowledge of accounting principles, including debits and credits, journal entries, account balances, and financial statement concepts.
Ability to process and reconcile cash, investment, partner capital, and commitment activity accurately.
Ability to review source documentation, prepare clear workpapers, and perform basic reasonableness and completeness checks.
Ability to investigate routine breaks and exceptions, document findings, and escalate unresolved or material matters.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel for organizing data, applying standard formulas, reconciling balances, and supporting analysis.
Effective communication with reviewers, managers, internal teams, and service partners.
Strong organization, follow-through, and time management in a deadline-driven environment.
Ability to explain established processes to less-experienced colleagues when requested.
Education And Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field.
A minimum of one year of experience in financial services, fund accounting, investment operations, or a related field is preferred.
Experience or knowledge of private markets, fund-of-funds structures, alternative investments or Investment accounting concept is an advantage.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel.
Effective written and verbal communication skills.
Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet reporting deadlines.
Demonstrated willingness to continue developing technical knowledge and assuming greater ownership of assigned deliverables.

Who We Are Looking For
We are hiring a Vice President to lead end-to-end testing delivery and quality assurance for Agentic AI solutions across Global Delivery Simplification.
This role serves as the operational owner of testing execution, responsible for ensuring agentic AI products are rigorously validated, risk-assessed, production-ready, and compliant with enterprise quality and control standards.
The role requires strong leadership across Quality Engineering, AI validation, operational risk management, and production readiness, ensuring agent-based solutions can be deployed safely and sustainably within a highly regulated financial services environment.
Why this role is important to us
The role is accountable for ensuring all solutions deployed into production have undergone comprehensive validation across functional, integration, operational, and AI-specific dimensions, with appropriate evidence, controls, and risk assessments supporting deployment decisions.
The position serves as the primary quality leader across delivery PODs and is responsible for driving consistent testing standards, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the AI delivery lifecycle.
What You Will Be Responsible For
Translate enterprise testing strategy into scalable testing plans, frameworks, and quality practices.
Lead end-to-end testing delivery across multiple Agentic AI initiatives and agile PODs.
Define test coverage, quality gates, acceptance criteria, and release readiness requirements.
Drive risk-based testing across functional, integration, operational, and AI-specific validation scenarios.
Ensure Agentic AI solutions are validated for accuracy, reliability, explainability, and regulatory compliance.
Lead testing of agent workflows, decision logic, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Establish testing standards, governance practices, and execution consistency across delivery teams.
Manage testing priorities, delivery milestones, risks, and resource allocation.
Own quality outcomes, including defect management, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure compliance with enterprise SDLC, control frameworks, Responsible AI standards, and audit requirements.
Lead production readiness reviews, and deployment validation activities.
Communicate testing progress, risks, and quality outcomes to senior stakeholders and governance forums.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Strong expertise in end-to-end testing lifecycle management, quality governance, and testing delivery leadership.
Ability to translate testing strategy into scalable execution frameworks and quality practices.
Deep understanding of risk-based testing methodologies, quality management, and production readiness processes.
Strong knowledge of Agentic AI concepts, autonomous workflows, AI-specific risks, and testing approaches.
Familiarity with AI observability, model performance monitoring, and validation practices.
Working knowledge of enterprise risk frameworks, SDLC governance standards, and regulatory expectations.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities with a focus on continuous improvement.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
8–10+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Testing, Validation, Quality Engineering, or related disciplines.
Proven experience leading testing delivery within complex enterprise technology environments, including agile and multi-team delivery models.
Strong understanding of SDLC, testing governance, quality management, defect management, and production readiness practices.
Experience supporting audit, risk, governance, and regulatory requirements within highly controlled environments.
Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders.
Experience with AI-enabled solutions, intelligent automation, or emerging technologies preferred; exposure to Agentic AI and Generative AI is highly desirable.

The role requires strong leadership across Quality Engineering, AI validation, operational risk management, and production readiness, ensuring agent-based solutions can be deployed safely and sustainably within a highly regulated financial services environment.

Why this role is important to us

The role is accountable for ensuring all solutions deployed into production have undergone comprehensive validation across functional, integration, operational, and AI-specific dimensions, with appropriate evidence, controls, and risk assessments supporting deployment decisions.

The position serves as the primary quality leader across delivery PODs and is responsible for driving consistent testing standards, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across the AI delivery lifecycle.

What You Will Be Responsible For

  • Translate enterprise testing strategy into scalable testing plans, frameworks, and quality practices.
  • Lead end-to-end testing delivery across multiple Agentic AI initiatives and agile PODs.
  • Define test coverage, quality gates, acceptance criteria, and release readiness requirements.
  • Drive risk-based testing across functional, integration, operational, and AI-specific validation scenarios.
  • Ensure Agentic AI solutions are validated for accuracy, reliability, explainability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Lead testing of agent workflows, decision logic, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop controls.

What We Value

These skills will help you succeed in this role

  • Strong expertise in end-to-end testing lifecycle management, quality governance, and testing delivery leadership.
  • Ability to translate testing strategy into scalable execution frameworks and quality practices.

  • Working knowledge of enterprise risk frameworks, SDLC governance standards, and regulatory expectations.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.
  • Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities with a focus on continuous improvement.


Education & Preferred Qualifications

  • 8–10+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Testing, Validation, Quality Engineering, or related disciplines.

jobs.title: Financial Reporting, Associate 1
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Description
Who we are looking for:
Responsible for the end-to-end preparation, analysis, and delivery of periodic (quarterly, semi-annual, annual and ad hoc) financial statements and related disclosures in accordance with IFRS, US GAAP, regulatory requirements, and client-specific reporting standards for alternative investment funds and registered funds, including Hedge, Private Equity, Fund-of-Funds, and other investment structures.
Why This Role Is Important To Us
The team you will be joining is part of State Street Global Delivery (SSGD). SSGD gives asset owners and managers access to the essential financial tools they need to deliver effective investment solutions. From core custody, accounting, fund administration and shareholder recordkeeping to complete operations solutions and servicing for alternative assets like OTC derivatives, private equity and real estate, SSGD’s tools help our clients make better investment choices and act on growth opportunities.
Join us if making your mark in the financial services industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As
Financial Reporting, Associate 1,
you will:
Set up and maintain reporting folders within shared drives and related reporting platforms for each fund throughout the reporting cycle, ensuring all supporting documentation for financial statement disclosures is obtained, validated, and properly organized. Research and resolve outstanding issues as required, and maintain accurate, complete, and well-structured records to support reporting, review, and audit requirements.
Prepare periodic financial statements:
Perform planning and readiness assessments prior to each reporting cycle to identify potential issues and collaborate with applicable parties to resolve.
Conduct detailed reviews of general ledger balances, identify exceptions or discrepancies, and drive issue resolution with internal applicable parties.
Analyze and validate financial statement balances and disclosures to ensure accuracy, completeness, and overall reasonableness.
Draft financial statements disclosures in compliance with applicable accounting standards, including IFRS and US GAAP requirements.
Adhere to established financial reporting procedures, complete all required task lists, and obtain appropriate sign-offs in accordance with internal policies.
Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend or implement technical initiatives to reporting procedures, controls, and workflows.
Ensure adherence to the financial statements production calendar.
Coordinate distribution of financial statements:
Assemble financial statements draft, all supporting documentation and calculations.
Managing the receipt of comments on financial statements drafts from external (and internal) parties. Ensure the timely research, resolution, and processing of comments.
Participating in the testing and implementation of financial reporting systems, platforms, and templates, while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, controls, and automation.
What We Value
These skills will help you succeed in this role
Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to identify issues, evaluate risks, and deliver effective solutions in a fast-paced environment.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree or above in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline.
Progress toward, or possession of, a recognized professional accounting qualification (e.g., CFA, CPA, ACCA, CA) is an asset.
Knowledge of preparation of financial statements (IFRS and US GAAP) is an asset.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, with advanced skills in Excel, including complex formulas, data validation, pivot tables, and financial reporting tools.
Effective English listening and written communication skills.
Superior attention to detail, time management, and organizational skills.
Ability to effectively work under pressure, meet tight deadlines, and deliver high-quality results.
Additional Requirements
Overtime may be required
Ability to work across time zones when required
Flexibility during peak reporting periods

We are seeking a candidate with strong Middle Office Operations experience and a sound financial background. The role may support Transaction Lifecyle Management, Portfolio Valuation, or Bank Loan services and involves partnering closely with clients, investment managers, custodians, counterparties, and internal teams to support daily operational activities, resolve exceptions, and address complex operational challenges. Education & Preferred Qualifications

jobs.descriptionText:
Who we are looking for
Fund Accountant Associate 2 will be responsible for supporting a range of operational and fund accounting activities for the client portfolio. The role requires a strong understanding of investment lifecycle events, operational controls and supporting documentation. The successful candidate will independently manage assigned responsibilities, investigate exceptions and work closely with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate service delivery.
Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), a leading provider of fund accounting, fund administration and operational support services to alternative investment managers and institutional investors.
The team acts as a key coordination and control point across the alternative investment servicing lifecycle. The team connects client requirements with operational execution, helps ensure that investment, transaction, cash, valuation and reporting information is complete and accurate, and drives timely resolution of exceptions. The role is important in maintaining service quality, strengthening the control environment and supporting scalable, technology-enabled delivery across private equity, private credit, fund-of-funds and direct investment structures.
What you will be responsible for
Independently process investment lifecycle events, including capital calls, distributions, interest receipts, fee transactions, paydowns and other investment-related activities..
Review and maintain supporting documentation received from agents, administrators and counterparties.
Support cash processing and cash reconciliation activities by comparing transaction records against supporting documentation and internal systems.
Assist in setup and maintenance of investment attributes and operational records within relevant platforms.
Monitor and investigate basic exceptions, missing information and reconciliation breaks.
Escalate issues and outstanding items promptly to senior team members.
Support preparation of operational reports and client deliverables.
Maintain accurate audit trails and document management records.
Follow established procedures, risk controls and information-security requirements.
Participate in process improvement initiatives and support testing activities when required.
What we value
This position provides an opportunity to gain exposure to a broad range of alternative investment products and operational activities, including private equity, private credit, fund-of-funds and other complex investment structures. The successful candidate will develop expertise in investment operations, cash management, documentation review and client servicing activities within a global operating environment.
We Value
Strong attention to detail
Ownership and accountability
Problem-solving mindset
Effective communication
Ability to work under pressure
Teamwork and collaboration
Continuous improvement mindset
Education And Preferred Qualifications
Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business or related discipline.
Approx 2 years related experience of relevant experience within fund accounting, fund administration, financial services or alternative investment operations.
Understanding of alternative investment structures and investment lifecycle events preferred.
Strong analytical and numerical skills.
Good Microsoft Excel skills.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong organisational and time-management skills.
Demonstrated ability to identify issues, investigate exceptions and escalate appropriately.
Role scope and working relationships
The Associate 2 role is critical in ensuring the completeness, accuracy and timeliness of operational processing while supporting a strong control environment and high-quality client service. The role works closely with middle-office and transaction-processing teams, document management, reconciliation, valuation, financial reporting, audit, technology, product and project-management partners. Responsibilities may vary by client, investment type and target operating model.

jobs.descriptionText:
Who we are looking for
Fund Accountant Associate 2 will be responsible for supporting a range of operational and fund accounting activities for the client portfolio. The role requires a strong understanding of investment lifecycle events, operational controls and supporting documentation. The successful candidate will independently manage assigned responsibilities, investigate exceptions and work closely with internal teams and external stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate service delivery.
Why this role is important to us
The team you will be joining is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), a leading provider of fund accounting, fund administration and operational support services to alternative investment managers and institutional investors.
The team acts as a key coordination and control point across the alternative investment servicing lifecycle. The team connects client requirements with operational execution, helps ensure that investment, transaction, cash, valuation and reporting information is complete and accurate, and drives timely resolution of exceptions. The role is important in maintaining service quality, strengthening the control environment and supporting scalable, technology-enabled delivery across private equity, private credit, fund-of-funds and direct investment structures.
What you will be responsible for
Independently process investment lifecycle events, including capital calls, distributions, interest receipts, fee transactions, paydowns and other investment-related activities..
Review and maintain supporting documentation received from agents, administrators and counterparties.
Support cash processing and cash reconciliation activities by comparing transaction records against supporting documentation and internal systems.
Assist in setup and maintenance of investment attributes and operational records within relevant platforms.
Monitor and investigate basic exceptions, missing information and reconciliation breaks.
Escalate issues and outstanding items promptly to senior team members.
Support preparation of operational reports and client deliverables.
Maintain accurate audit trails and document management records.
Follow established procedures, risk controls and information-security requirements.
Participate in process improvement initiatives and support testing activities when required.
What we value
This position provides an opportunity to gain exposure to a broad range of alternative investment products and operational activities, including private equity, private credit, fund-of-funds and other complex investment structures. The successful candidate will develop expertise in investment operations, cash management, documentation review and client servicing activities within a global operating environment.
We Value
Strong attention to detail
Ownership and accountability
Problem-solving mindset
Effective communication
Ability to work under pressure
Teamwork and collaboration
Continuous improvement mindset
Education And Preferred Qualifications
Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business or related discipline.
Approx 2 years related experience of relevant experience within fund accounting, fund administration, financial services or alternative investment operations.
Understanding of alternative investment structures and investment lifecycle events preferred.
Strong analytical and numerical skills.
Good Microsoft Excel skills.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong organisational and time-management skills.
Demonstrated ability to identify issues, investigate exceptions and escalate appropriately.
Role scope and working relationships
The Associate 2 role is critical in ensuring the completeness, accuracy and timeliness of operational processing while supporting a strong control environment and high-quality client service. The role works closely with middle-office and transaction-processing teams, document management, reconciliation, valuation, financial reporting, audit, technology, product and project-management partners. Responsibilities may vary by client, investment type and target operating model.

jobs.descriptionText:
Who We Are Looking For
This leadership role supports a diverse portfolio of global hedge fund, fund of funds, and hybrid fund clients. Reporting to a Vice President, the AVP is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end delivery of fund administration services, ensuring timely and accurate NAV production, a strong control environment, and exceptional client service. The role provides leadership to a team of professionals, driving talent development, operational excellence, risk management, and continuous improvement. The AVP also leads strategic initiatives, including process transformation, management reporting, BCP, and risk and control programs, to enhance operational efficiency and client outcomes.
Why This Role Is Important To Us
The team you will be joining is part of
Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS)
, a recognized industry leader in providing fund accounting, fund administration, and risk services to hedge funds, private markets, and other alternative investment vehicles. AIS delivers fully integrated solutions across the investment lifecycle, providing clients with comprehensive front-, middle-, and back-office support to meet the evolving needs of institutional investors.
Join us if making your mark in the alternative investment industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
What You Will Be Responsible For
As Hedge Fund Accounting AVP you will be responsible for
Managing Internal Operations
Ensure monthly and quarterly client deliverables meet or exceed clients’ expectation:
Review NAV calculations, fee calculations and other client reporting
Coordinate annual audit with external accounting firms
Respond to ad hoc client requests and queries promptly
Review fund governing agreements and offering memorandums to ensure alignment of operational and accounting procedures
Prepare and maintain robust operational processes and internal controls in accordance with State Street policies
Drive operational excellence by ensuring service level agreements (SLAs), accuracy, timeliness, and key performance indicators (KPIs) are consistently achieved.
Client/homesite Relationship Management
Build and maintain strong relationships with client/homesite partners through regular engagement and proactive communication.
Develop a deep understanding of client needs and business objectives, and coordinate across teams to deliver effective solutions and support.
Act as a key escalation point for client issues, driving timely resolution and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction.
Take ownership of client communications, service delivery, and follow-up actions, fostering trusted partnerships and enhancing the overall client experience.
Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to identify service enhancement opportunities and support business growth initiatives.
New Client Onboarding
Lead and oversee the onboarding of new clients and business transitions, ensuring a seamless and controlled implementation process.
Partner with clients, homesite teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate onboarding activities, manage risks, and ensure all deliverables are completed on time.
Drive effective resource planning and delegation to support successful onboarding and ongoing service delivery.
Staff Management
Provide leadership, guidance, and day-to-day oversight to the team to ensure high-quality service delivery.
Coach, develop, and motivate team members, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
Drive the performance management process, including goal setting, regular feedback, and performance evaluations.
Project Management
Lead and contribute to strategic client, operational, and business initiatives.
Drive process improvement, automation, and control enhancement initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, and client outcomes.
Champion innovation and the adoption of AI and digital solutions to improve productivity, effectiveness, and client outcomes.
Risk Management
Maintain a strong risk and control environment through adherence to internal policies, procedures, and control standards.
Proactively identify, assess, and remediate operational risks and control gaps.
Lead the investigation and resolution of operational incidents, ensuring timely corrective actions.
Ensure compliance with internal and external audit requirements and regulatory obligations.
What We Value
This managerial role requires a strong combination of leadership, client relationship management, operational excellence, and risk management capabilities, supported by deep industry experience. The ideal candidate demonstrates strategic thinking, sound judgment, and a growth mindset, leveraging AI and digital solutions to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, strengthen controls, and deliver superior client and business outcomes.
Education & Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree and/or professional qualifications such as CPA, CFA, ACCA is a plus
At least 8 years working experience in accounting / financial services related environment
A minimum of 3 years people management experience
Strong hedge fund administration experience, including performance fee calculations, hot issue allocations, share class accounting, and allocation methodologies
Deep understanding of alternative investment products and accounting treatments, including derivatives, swaps, options, futures, and forwards.
Experience with fund accounting platforms is highly desirable.
Proven leadership, client management, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive operational excellence and business objectives.
Strong decision-making and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across teams, functions, and regions.
Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and communicate complex matters clearly to clients and stakeholders at all levels.
Demonstrated commitment to talent development, inclusion, and building high-performing teams.
Flexibility to support global stakeholders across different time zones when required.
About State Street
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. The AVP also leads strategic initiatives, including process transformation, management reporting, BCP, and risk and control programs, to enhance operational efficiency and client outcomes.

Why This Role Is Important To Us

The team you will be joining is part of Alternative Investment Solutions (AIS), a recognized industry leader in providing fund accounting, fund administration, and risk services to hedge funds, private markets, and other alternative investment vehicles. AIS delivers fully integrated solutions across the investment lifecycle, providing clients with comprehensive front-, middle-, and back-office support to meet the evolving needs of institutional investors.

Join us if making your mark in the alternative investment industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.

What You Will Be Responsible For

As Hedge Fund Accounting AVP you will be responsible for

Managing Internal Operations

  • Ensure monthly and quarterly client deliverables meet or exceed clients’ expectation:
    • Review NAV calculations, fee calculations and other client reporting
    • Coordinate annual audit with external accounting firms
    • Respond to ad hoc client requests and queries promptly
  • Review fund governing agreements and offering memorandums to ensure alignment of operational and accounting procedures
  • Prepare and maintain robust operational processes and internal controls in accordance with State Street policies
  • Drive operational excellence by ensuring service level agreements (SLAs), accuracy, timeliness, and key performance indicators (KPIs) are consistently achieved.

Client/homesite Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with client/homesite partners through regular engagement and proactive communication.
  • Develop a deep understanding of client needs and business objectives, and coordinate across teams to deliver effective solutions and support.
  • Act as a key escalation point for client issues, driving timely resolution and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction.
  • Take ownership of client communications, service delivery, and follow-up actions, fostering trusted partnerships and enhancing the overall client experience.
  • Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to identify service enhancement opportunities and support business growth initiatives.


New Client Onboarding

  • Lead and oversee the onboarding of new clients and business transitions, ensuring a seamless and controlled implementation process.
  • Partner with clients, homesite teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to coordinate onboarding activities, manage risks, and ensure all deliverables are completed on time.
  • Drive effective resource planning and delegation to support successful onboarding and ongoing service delivery.


Staff Management

  • Provide leadership, guidance, and day-to-day oversight to the team to ensure high-quality service delivery.
  • Coach, develop, and motivate team members, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Drive the performance management process, including goal setting, regular feedback, and performance evaluations.


Project Management

  • Lead and contribute to strategic client, operational, and business initiatives.
  • Drive process improvement, automation, and control enhancement initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, and client outcomes.
  • Champion innovation and the adoption of AI and digital solutions to improve productivity, effectiveness, and client outcomes.


Risk Management

  • Maintain a strong risk and control environment through adherence to internal policies, procedures, and control standards.
  • Proactively identify, assess, and remediate operational risks and control gaps.
  • Lead the investigation and resolution of operational incidents, ensuring timely corrective actions.
  • Ensure compliance with internal and external audit requirements and regulatory obligations.


What We Value

This managerial role requires a strong combination of leadership, client relationship management, operational excellence, and risk management capabilities, supported by deep industry experience. The ideal candidate demonstrates strategic thinking, sound judgment, and a growth mindset, leveraging AI and digital solutions to drive innovation, enhance efficiency, strengthen controls, and deliver superior client and business outcomes.
